title: Filter from a uniform prior
description: You initialize free-cell probabilities and compute the belief sequence.

steps.description: You allocate one zero probability for each of the N grid positions. This creates the initial belief vector b0.

steps.question: Which positions receive positive initial probability?
steps.answer: Only free_states receive 1 divided by the number of free states. Every free cell receives the same probability.

steps.description: You pass b0 into forward_filter with the actions and observations. The call uses the simulation's transition matrices and the supplied sensor_correct value.
You print the length of the returned belief sequence. The recording reports T+1 = 17.
